name: Halo
note: White and vertical. Identity up top, Chat and Voice in one panel, live transcript.
_comment: These are the same values templates/webchat-webrtc/src/styles.css declares
on :root. The duplication is deliberate and is what makes the design
editable: a demo folder holds its own COPY of the template source, so a CSS
edit only reaches demos created afterwards, while this block is injected by
the service at request time and reaches every demo on the next refresh.
Custom starts as a copy of this, which is why it has to be complete.
No --webrtc-* block: the combination renders the demo's own shell, so
Cognigy's click-to-call container is not on this page to style.
